_comment: The machine-readable contract for @openmasjid/ui. This file is AUTHORITATIVE:
packages/core/test/ui-design-gates.test.ts reads it and checks the code against it,
rather than the two carrying separate copies of the same numbers.
A downstream app can read it to learn what the design system guarantees.
Update it in the same commit as the change it describes.

basis.note: React Bits Pro was evaluated and rejected on licensing — see docs/design-system/PREREQUISITES.md §1
basis.classMerge: cn (shadcn) — replaces clsx + tailwind-merge; lib/cn.ts is the swap seam

accent.runtime: applyAccent writes --color-primary, --color-btn and --color-on-primary inline on <html>, which beats the stylesheet. Never assume the stylesheet value is the live one.

gateBudgets._comment: Each is the current measured count. Ratchets: exceeding one is a regression, going under asks you to lower it here so the win cannot be spent again.
